name: Didone Signal
concept: High-contrast serif display against tangerine and black pills — masthead grammar on a product page.

type.families: A high-contrast display serif for headlines (Playfair Display, Prata, Bodoni Moda, Instrument Serif) paired with a plain neo-grotesque for everything else. The pairing is the style — never set a headline in the sans.
type.hierarchy: Hero serif 72/74 regular · section serif 44/50 regular · sans body 16/26 regular · sans label 12/16 medium ALL-CAPS 0.08em. The serif appears only at display sizes; below 24px it is always the sans.
type.usage: Centre the hero. Let the serif's thick-thin contrast do the decorating — no italic, no underline, no colour on the headline. Body copy is quiet grey sans.

tokens.texture: Print-flat. No gradients on surfaces, no glass, no glow. The one material moment is a soft photograph (cloud, sky, landscape) that dissolves into the page background behind the hero type via a mask or a white gradient. The signature component is a black pill button with a circular tangerine arrow chip welded onto its trailing end.
tokens.layout: Editorial symmetry. Centred hero with a tight measure (max 20 characters per headline line), generous 120px+ section rhythm, 8px scale. Cards are black or white rectangles with 16-20px radius. A flat tangerine field ruled with a faint architectural grid works as a section break.

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as soft natural photograph, high-key, dissolving into white.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- paper-white ground the image fades into with no hard edge
- soft natural light — clouds, sky, or diffused landscape
- muted natural palette with one tangerine #E85A00 note
- high-key exposure, gentle contrast
- generous symmetrical composition

NEGATIVE SPACE: The upper half fades to near-white so a serif headline can sit over it.

DO NOT INCLUDE: dark or moody grading, neon, 3D render, vector illustration, harsh shadows, busy compositions.
